description: Defines the 'Unit' struct for representing measurement units with conversion capabilities, including parsing, comparison, and formatting.

classes.name: Unit
classes.description: A struct representing a measurement unit with value and type, supporting conversions, comparisons, and string formatting.

methods.name: FromCentimeter
methods.description: Creates a Unit instance with type set to centimeters.

methods.name: FromMillimeter
methods.description: Creates a Unit instance with type set to millimeters.

methods.name: FromPoint
methods.description: Creates a Unit instance with type set to points.

methods.name: FromInch
methods.description: Creates a Unit instance with type set to inches.

methods.name: FromPica
methods.description: Creates a Unit instance with type set to picas.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string to create a Unit object, interpreting suffixes like 'cm', 'in', etc.

methods.name: ConvertType
methods.description: Converts the unit to another specified UnitType.
